description: Call an endpoint of a request's draft before it is published, to check it returns the right data. Only endpoints get_build_status shows as ready answer. Draft calls cost no credits. Needs an API key with a request permission.

endpoint.description: The endpoint path as get_build_status lists it, e.g. "/reviews".

request_id.description: The request_id from request_endpoint or create_api.

name: call_draft
title: Call a draft maviapi endpoint
